_comment: Dashboard 3: Per-Team/Project Comparison (within a single project). VERIFY 'componentHealthCheck' widgetType and its 'widgetOptions.attributeKey' field name against GET /api/v1/{project}/widget on the target RP 5.15 instance. This widget groups results by the CI-supplied launch attribute named here (default: 'service') -- see dashboard-kit/ci-examples/ATTRIBUTES.md for the tagging convention (team:/layer:/service:). Swap attributeKey to 'layer' or 'team' if a project prefers grouping by test layer or by sub-team instead of service.

widgets.name: Recent Launches by Attribute
widgets.description: Most recent launches with their team/layer/service attributes visible for quick comparison.

widgets.name: Component Health by Service
widgets.description: Pass/fail breakdown grouped by the 'service' launch attribute, for comparing sub-teams/components within this project.
